name: Raptor Global Product Add-ons – Upsells & Rules for WooCommerce
author: Amr Issa

sections.description:
Raptor Global Add-ons – Upsells & Rules lets you create add-ons once and assign them globally to all products, specific categories, or individual products. Perfect for gift wrapping, personalization options, and more.

Key Features

  • Smart Add-on Management – Create add-ons once, use everywhere
  • Flexible Assignments – Assign to all products, categories, tags, or specific products
  • Multiple Display Templates – Choose from 5 display styles
  • Variation Support – Create add-ons with multiple options and pricing
  • Priority System – Control the display order of multiple add-ons
  • Cart Integration – Full WooCommerce cart and checkout support

Display Templates

  • Choice Pills – Compact pill-shaped buttons
  • Simple List – Traditional checkbox/radio list

Features

  • Create unlimited add-on products
  • Assign to all products or product categories
  • 2 display templates (Choice Pills, Simple List)
  • Single and multiple selection modes
  • Priority-based display ordering
  • Full cart and checkout integration
  • Customizable styling options

Perfect For

  • Gift wrapping and packaging options
  • Personalization and engraving services
  • Insurance and add-on services
  • Upsells and cross-sells
  • Rush processing or priority shipping

Quick Start

Create your first add-on in 5 steps

  1. Go to Smart Add-ons > Add-ons and click Add New Add-on
  2. Enter a product name (e.g. “Gift Wrapping”)
  3. Set Product type to Smart Add-on
  4. Add an attribute (e.g. “Option”) and create variations (e.g. Standard, Premium) with prices
  5. Click Manage Rules next to your add-on and choose where to display it (e.g. All products)

Your add-on will now appear on product pages according to your rules.

Troubleshooting

Add-ons don’t appear on product pages

  • Ensure the add-on product is Published
  • Check that assignment rules match the product (e.g. category, product, or global)
  • Verify no exclusion rules block the add-on (Pro)

Color swatches don’t show

  • Set a Swatch Color for each variation in the Variations tab
  • Variations without a color are intentionally hidden

Wrong display template or styling

  • Go to Smart Add-ons > Settings to adjust appearance (colors, borders, free label)
  • Ensure you’ve saved the add-on product after changing the Display Template
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/wpraptor-global-addons-upsells-rules/ or install through the WordPress Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen
  3. Go to Smart Add-ons in the admin menu to manage add-ons
  4. Create add-on products using the “Smart Add-on” product type
  5. Assign add-ons to products using the “Manage Rules” button

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or greater
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or greater
  • PHP 7.4 or greater
sections.faq:
How do I create a global add-on?

  1. Go to Smart Add-ons > Add-ons and click Add New Add-on (or Products > Add New and select “Smart Add-on” as product type)
  2. Add variations with pricing, or use single add-on mode for one option
  3. In Smart Add-ons > Add-ons, click Manage Rules for the add-on you need to edit
  4. Configure assignments (e.g. all products, specific categories, or specific products)

Can I assign add-ons to specific categories?

Yes. You can assign add-ons to specific product categories. Pro users can also assign to specific products, tags, user roles, or individual users.

How do exclusions work?

Exclusions prevent add-ons from appearing on specific products even when they match assignment rules. This is a Pro feature.

Can customers select multiple add-on options?

Yes. Each add-on can use single selection (radio buttons) or multiple selection (checkboxes). Color Swatches and Modern List use fixed selection modes.

Are add-on prices added to the product price?

Yes. Selected add-on prices are automatically added to the cart total.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes. Global add-ons work with all WooCommerce product types as long as they have a price displayed

How do Color Swatches work?

Color Swatches is a Pro template. Select it for your add-on, then in the Variations tab set a Swatch Color for each variation. Variations without a color set will not appear on the frontend. Color variants display even if they have no price.

Where do add-ons appear on the product page?

Add-ons can be displayed in several positions: before the Add to Cart button, after it, after the product meta, after the short description, or after the full product. Configure this in the display settings when managing rules for each add-on.

How do I change the order of add-ons?

Use the Sort Priority field in each add-on’s product data. Lower numbers appear first. You can also change priority in bulk from the Add-ons list.

Can I customize how add-ons look?

Yes. Go to Smart Add-ons > Settings to customize primary color, price color, border style (sharp, rounded, or pill-shaped), and the label for free add-ons.

Is there a limit on how many add-ons I can create?

No. You can create unlimited add-on products in both the free and Pro versions.

Can I import or export my add-on settings?

Yes. Smart Add-ons > Settings includes an Import/Export section. You can export settings, add-ons, and assignments to a JSON file for backup or migration to another site.

What happens if a customer doesn’t select an add-on?

Add-ons are optional by default. The product can be added to the cart without selecting any add-on. If you need an add-on to be required, you would need to handle that through your theme or additional custom code.
